title: Idli
description: Idli is a India dish made with idli rice, urad dal, sambar powder. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Soak the listed rice, grains or noodles in clean water for about 480 minutes as appropriate, then drain; grind rice and urad for batter if required by this dish.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Leave the mixed rice-and-legume batter loosely covered in a clean warm place for about 720 minutes until aerated and tangy. Fermentation times vary; avoid overheating.
Pour fermented batter into lightly oiled idli molds and steam covered until fluffy and fully set, about 14–16 minutes.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
